StrategyWiki: no usable walkthrough, nothing used — https://strategywiki.org/wiki/Dragon_Quest_VII_Reimagined
Fandom (dragonquest.fandom.com, CC BY-SA): page names only were checked to confirm structure; no text copied — https://dragonquest.fandom.com/wiki/Dragon_Quest_VII_Reimagined
notes: Backlog game, all-AAA pass: picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year across all genres (docs/PLAN.md section 2, genre filter widened 2026-10-23). This is the remake's own Steam app (2499860, "DRAGON QUEST VII Reimagined"); RAWG keeps the 2000 original as a separate entry ("dragon-quest-7"). StrategyWiki has a stub page (completion stage 0, in Category:Stubs); its Table of Contents, Walkthrough and Gameplay are linked but no subpage exists, so nothing was used. dragonquest.fandom.com answers the API, with about 361 linked pages, including "Estard Island" and "Vocation system (Dragon Quest VII)"; names only were looked at, nothing copied. The Steam schema calls the app "doll" (an internal codename). 51 of 61 Steam achievements are hidden. 33 of them come first in the Steam list and look like story steps; they are split into early, middle and late chapters by list order and unlock rate, which is an estimate ("Legends of the Forgotten Past", 3.9%, is first in the list but has the lowest rate, so it sits in the late chapter). The other 18 hidden ones sit among the battle and collection goals in the Steam list and get their own Hidden Side Goals chapter; their names hint at series of ranks, but what they track is not in the data.
